notes.title: Menu Update and Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone, how are you?

Well, this update was about the menu. I took a while to launch it because I had issues with my old Steam number, but here it is. For now, I’m focused on continuing to improve the essential parts of the game. I’ll be adding a distance tracker, a leaderboard, achievements, etc. Since I need to create art for the achievement icons, it might take me a week or more (I’m terrible at drawing).

This launch was really disastrous due to the lack of content. As I mentioned before, I thought a hyper-casual game would be fine.

For now, that’s all. I’ll be back next week with the leaderboard and score system. I’m planning to rework the car system, giving them a real physics simulation because it’s really WAY TOO ARCADE, haha.

Big hugs, and I hope everyone can enjoy playing!

P.S.: I’ve reduced the game price to $1.

Additions:
Menu to adjust individual volume for effects and music
Fixed a world generation bug where it would sometimes stop generating in front of the player due to acceleration changes
For the Future:
Leaderboard integrated with the Steam API
Physics simulation for cars
Gear system
Denser and livelier traffic
Big hugs, and happy gaming to everyone!

(You can switch the game to windowed mode by pressing F11)

notes.title: some changes
notes.content:
Sure! Here’s the translation:

---

Hello everyone! First of all, I want to say that I’m the only one coding this game, haha. So I'm aware of the lack of objectives to encourage longer gameplay. Primarily, the game was designed to be a time killer—just jump in, play a bit while waiting for another game, and then leave. Keeping that in mind, I’ll be expanding it by adding Steam leaderboards and various ways to encourage longer gameplay.

I didn’t include a menu because it’s an extremely light game, but maybe tomorrow I’ll add a fully functional menu.

Cheers, and happy gaming to everyone!

--- 

Let me know if you need anything else!
